portfolio.title: Selected works by our creator
portfolio.intro: Explore Hatt’s personal and publicly shared work, then follow the links to related creative services.

desert-sketch.title: Sailing across the desert
desert-sketch.description: A monochrome scene of a sail, dunes and a figure. Explore the atmosphere and the sense of a story within the image.
desert-sketch.alt: Monochrome illustration of a figure in a sailing vehicle crossing the desert

centipede.title: A centipede carrying a pillbox
centipede.description: A creature carrying gun turrets. The design combines organic and mechanical forms with detailed drawing.
centipede.alt: Monochrome illustration of a many-legged creature carrying gun turrets

moku.title: モク / Moku
moku.description: A fox-boy avatar for VRChat. The introduction shows its expressions, glasses and changes of clothing.
moku.alt: Introduction image of Moku, a 3D fox avatar wearing glasses

bright-friend.title: あかるい友達 / Bright Friend
bright-friend.description: An avatar light in handheld, lantern and staff-lantern forms. The video shows light adjustment and responsive movement.
bright-friend.alt: Bright Friend 3D work showing a small glowing character and a lantern

letter.title: 「手紙」 / Letter
letter.description: A short story set in a laboratory. Read the Japanese text to explore Hatt’s choice of words and narrative construction.

buying-mittens.title: 手袋を買いに / Buying Mittens
buying-mittens.description: Hatt reads a story by Niimi Nankichi in this public video. Listen to the voice, pace and pauses of the reading.
buying-mittens.credit: Original story: Niimi Nankichi / Reading: Hatt
